news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CFO Louis Tamayo Sells 4,641 Shares
news.summary: CFO Louis Tamayo sold 4,641 shares on July 1, 2026 at a weighted-average price of about $4.49 to cover tax withholding on vested RSUs, while CEO Nolan Townsend made a similar tax-related sale of 25,947 shares the same day. Both disposals were mechanical tax-withholding transactions tied to RSU vesting rather than discretionary open-market selling.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CEO and CFO Receive Annual RSU Compensation Grants
news.summary: CEO Nolan Townsend was awarded 67,000 restricted stock units as part of routine executive compensation, with CFO Louis Tamayo receiving a smaller 12,000-unit grant on the same date. The grants are standard equity awards and are not indicative of a change in company outlook.

news.headline: JPMorgan Trims Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $9 from $12, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: JPMorgan lowered its price target on LXEO to $9 from $12 on June 25, 2026 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing an updated valuation model following the company's recent LX2006 pipeline and regulatory developments. The firm remains constructive on Lexeo's long-term gene therapy opportunity despite the lower near-term target.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Holds 2026 Virtual Annual Meeting, Elects Directors
news.summary: Lexeo held its fully virtual 2026 annual stockholders meeting, where shareholders elected three Class III directors to terms running through 2029 and ratified KPMG LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics LX2006 Friedreich Ataxia Data Published in JAMA Cardiology
news.summary: Peer-reviewed Phase I/II data on 17 Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy patients treated with LX2006 was published in JAMA Cardiology, showing sustained cardiac and neurologic improvements, favorable biomarker changes, and a generally well-tolerated safety profile. The publication reinforces the clinical rationale underpinning the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial design.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Finalizes SUNRISE-FA2 Pivotal Trial Design for LX2006 with FDA
news.summary: Lexeo finalized the protocol and statistical analysis plan for its pivotal, open-label SUNRISE-FA2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, an externally-controlled study comparing LVMI change in 13 treated versus 13 untreated patients, with enrollment targeted to begin by end of June 2026. Shares jumped roughly 13% on the news, which keeps the program on track for a topline readout in H2 2027 and a BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway in H1 2028.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and pipeline updates in August 2026; an exact date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose data (HEROIC-PKP2)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a 12-month data update covering all high-dose PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy participants in the ongoing HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data comparing LVMI change between treated and untreated arms of the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy is guided for the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Lexeo plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway in the first half of 2028, contingent on positive SUNRISE-FA2 results.

pulse: Lexeo remains a clinical-stage genetic medicine company advancing two lead cardiac AAV gene therapy programs, LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy and LX2020 for PKP2-related arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, plus an earlier-stage APOE4 Alzheimer's program (LX1001). The mid-June finalization of the FDA-aligned SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal trial design sent shares sharply higher and was followed by supportive LX2006 data in JAMA Cardiology, even as JPMorgan trimmed its price target to $9 (still Overweight) on June 25 and the stock continues to trade in the mid-single digits. Near-term watch items are Q2 2026 earnings expected in August, 12-month high-dose LX2020 data due in Q4 2026, and the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 topline readout anticipated in the second half of 2027 ahead of a planned 2028 BLA filing.
